data.source: official Alpaca CLI 0.0.14 authenticated read-only endpoints

family: sector basket lead predicts lagging QQQ/IWM catch-up, executed in shares
limitations: May-Sep is rolling/pseudo-OOS because prior attempts revealed part of the period.
15-minute OHLC cannot establish intrabar ordering, so same-bar stop is assumed first.
IEX is not the full SIP.
Short-sale borrow availability and live spread can differ from historical assumptions.

production_contract.bracket: one-cent prices with after-cost target:stop >=3; stop-first same-bar convention; six-bar timeout
production_contract.execution: next 15-minute QQQ/IWM bar open; $10,000 max notional; long/short shares
production_contract.risk: global maximum one open strategy position; reject unavailable shorts and stale bars
production_contract.routing: existing AFTERIMAGE warrant, governor, serialized Alpaca executor, lifecycle reconciler, and evidence vault
production_contract.signal_time: 11:45, 13:15, or 14:15 America/New_York after named stock bar completes
